lessons.problem: Attaching a collection-scope `image` field also becomes the default image of EVERY token, and it beats the render effect. Every thumbnail turns into your logo. It can't be cleared afterwards: the field store rejects empty values.
lessons.fix: Never set collection `image`. Put the logo in `featured_image` and the banner in `banner_image` (collection-only keys).
lessons.changeNote: 0.4.2 warns before a collection image masks every token render. The field still can't be cleared once set.

lessons.problem: `--721c recommended` only resolves on testnets; the CLI has no recommended validator for Base mainnet.
lessons.fix: Pass OpenSea's StrictAuthorizedTransferSecurityRegistry explicitly: --721c 0xA000027A9B2802E1ddf7000061001e5c005A0000 (same bytecode on Base mainnet). Once enrolled, only OpenSea-authorized secondary sales pass; the owner can suspend with `abx set-transfer-validator <addr> none`.
lessons.fixNote: 0.4.2 added Base mainnet's recommended 721C validator (the same OpenSea registry), so `--721c recommended` works from 0.4.2.

lessons.problem: ABX's hosted renderer captures thumbnails at 1000x1000 and ignores the `render.aspectRatio` param, so a portrait or landscape piece comes out letterboxed.
lessons.fix: Design square, or accept letterboxed thumbnails (the live view is unaffected).
lessons.detect: render_check reports the canvas aspect ratio

lessons.problem: The hosted renderer waits about 10 s for `abx.done()`. A slower render is captured half-drawn.
lessons.fix: Keep the slowest seed well under 10 s at 1000 px on an ordinary machine (target under 5 s). Call abx.done() only when the final frame is drawn.

lessons.problem: Scripts over 22,000 bytes are split into chunks at newlines and re-joined with a newline. A 22 kB minified line can't be split safely.
lessons.fix: Keep line breaks in the uploaded code; one chunk (under 22,000 bytes) is simplest.

lessons.problem: With --onchain-uri the on-chain tokenURI carries a placeholder image and NO attributes; traits computed in JS only exist at the resolver. Marketplaces then show no image and no traits.
lessons.fix: Use hosted metadata (--public-base-url https://resolver.abx.io). The code and seed stay on-chain either way; prove it with rebuild_token.

lessons.problem: OpenSea indexes a fresh mint before its ABX render exists and caches the placeholder SVG and empty traits.
lessons.fix: Refresh each new mint after the render lands (OpenSea API: POST /api/v2/chain/base/contract/<addr>/nfts/<id>/refresh, free key), sometimes several times. The item page shows the real art via animation_url meanwhile.

lessons.problem: mainnet.base.org rate-limits (HTTP 429) during normal mint-page polling and CLI reads.
lessons.fix: Set ABX_RPC_URLS_BASE to a list, e.g. https://base-rpc.publicnode.com,https://base.drpc.org,https://mainnet.base.org, and use the same order on your mint page.
lessons.fixNote: the CLI fails over across public RPCs by default from 0.4.2. Your own mint page still needs its own fallback list.

lessons.problem: Wallet extensions such as Temple take over window.ethereum, so the CLI's local signing page talks to the wrong wallet. MetaMask must also already be on the right network.
lessons.fix: Disable other wallet extensions while signing; switch MetaMask to Base (8453) or Base Sepolia (84532) first; reload the signing page before each approval in a chained command.

lessons.problem: Math.random, Date.now or performance-based randomness make a token render differently each time, so thumbnails, traits and the live view disagree. `abx inspect` also trips on Math.random.
lessons.fix: Derive all randomness from abx.tokenData.seed (e.g. fold it into a 32-bit PRNG like mulberry32).

lessons.problem: --sponsor makes ABX's creator wallet sign and pay; that wallet shows as the contract creator on explorers forever.
lessons.fix: Either deploy from your own wallet (a few cents of gas on Base), or sponsor setup and finish with `abx set-admin <addr> --to <your wallet> --sponsor` so you own it, and say so publicly.

lessons.problem: Even with the script locked, the owner can still add a param hook (a transfer hook can block transfers or mints).
lessons.fix: Once the sale setup is final, `abx lock-param-hooks <addr>` (1 tx) so collectors can trust nothing changes.

lessons.problem: An unlocked script can be replaced by the owner at any time, which changes every token.
lessons.fix: Test on testnet, then `abx lock-script <addr>` before the public sale.

lessons.problem: ABX only knows Art Blocks' dependency registry on Ethereum and Sepolia. On Base a `--dep p5@1.9.0` reference has no registry, so ABX's resolver loads the library from a CDN (jsdelivr): the live view depends on that CDN, not on chain data.
lessons.fix: Zero-dependency vanilla JS is the fully on-chain path. If you need a library, pick a version stored on-chain in Art Blocks' registry (list_libraries) so the piece can still be rebuilt from chain data (rebuild_token pulls it from Ethereum), or deploy the library as a data contract on Base and add it with `--dep 0x…`.
